crossRefs.note: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness.…
Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey…
He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone…

parallels.note: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either…
Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other…

translations.web: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
translations.bsb: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like this had ever been made for any kingdom.
translations.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
translations.asv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
